player_screen_locus.method: wr2_camera.py --locus: register consecutive frames by phase correlation on a Hann-windowed DC-removed terrain crop (x60 y90 w1216 h768); accumulate the post-registration residual, which is large exactly where content is stationary in SCREEN space; take the smoothed peak inside the play area
player_screen_locus.reproducibility: identical (974,483) in two independent 30 s windows 1000 s apart and in different zones: pts 5290-5320 (peak 72.6 vs mean 6.67) and pts 6300-6330 (peak 74.0 vs mean 7.07)
player_screen_locus.note: this is the player sprite's visual-mass centre, not its ground point; the ground point is ~100 px lower (y~583), read off the release frame

caster_screen_position.method: wr2_caster_pos.py: the monster's over-head '(cur/max)' readout is a rigid marker for that monster's screen position; detected by bright-achromatic band, h 8-16, w 45-260, >=6 ink groups, paren at each end

nova_signature.windup: compact cyan bloom on the caster; cold mask B>150, B-R>60, B>=G-12; rms radius stays <110 px while count climbs
nova_signature.release: 16 white-headed frost lances launched radially; cold rms radius climbs ~linearly while count falls

fct.rule: min(RGB)>140 and chroma<45, horizontal close DIL=4, 7<=h<=26, 8<=w<=90, reject y-bands carrying >115 px of ink (kills the monster HP readout), track across frames, keep n>=4

cast_A.identity: Primordian, the Forgotten One (Beastkin) frigidring nova, R2 regime

q1_floaters_per_nova.reason: this build renders NO floating combat text for damage TAKEN by the player; FCT is damage DEALT only

cast_A_floaters.note: none matches either the player HP drop (127 @f309060, >=543 @f309085) or the boss HP readout deltas (38-77 per step); they are hits the player dealt to other targets

substitute_evidence_for_multi_hit.inference: >=2 projectiles landed, unless the single hit critted
substitute_evidence_for_multi_hit.geometry: the player's ground point lay ~30 px from the nova launch origin, i.e. INSIDE the launch ring; at that radius adjacent projectile paths are ~12 px apart, far narrower than one lance, so multiple projectile paths necessarily crossed the player's footprint

q2_knockback.verdict: ZERO measurable displacement at every measured impact
q2_knockback.unit: native px of camera pan per frame (camera is player-locked, so pan == player world displacement)

events.note: player stationary for >=18 frames before and >=10 after; pan is exactly 0 px through the impact
player running; smooth heading change, no impulse
player stationary before and after; pan exactly 0 px

q2_knockback.detection_floor: 1 px of camera pan in a single frame; at castA and h4 the reading is exactly 0 for >=10 frames each side, so any knockback is < 1 px = < 0.001 screen heights

q3_distance_from_caster.metric_conversion: CANNOT-ANSWER -- no pixel-anchorable scale reference exists in this footage; no in-frame object of known world size, no scale bar, and the minimap carries no legend

cast_A.regime: MELEE CONTACT -- the two sprites visibly overlap in evidence/strip-death2-f309020-309124.jpg; separation is ~1/3 of the werewolf sprite's own width

phase2_separation_distribution.window: f313700-f315900 sampled every 10 frames, Primordian readout only (groups>=14, w>=130)
phase2_separation_distribution.note: the whole observed engagement range for this boss is 11-283 px; cast A at 57.5 px sits in the lower quartile

gear_step_is_not_a_step.finding: max HP does NOT make a single jump 759 -> 1607; it walks through a ~470 s gear-tinkering window with reversals

R3_6030_6610.interpretation: no monster in R3 carries 5-digit health

R3_encounter_census.R3_engagement_shape: 16 engagements, 1-29 kills each (median 12), from agentic_orchestration/galadriel/captures/2026-07-26-gd-playtest-v1-tb/tb-rollup-engagements.csv -- pack signature, not boss signature

q4_composition_audit.verdict: R3 contains NO boss-grade encounter. The 2.12-vs-1.22 worst-fall/EHP gap is at minimum PARTLY a composition confound: the only boss in the fixture is fought exclusively in R2.
